newsitem.title: BELGIUM: KB, Rabobank in alliance talks - magazine.
newsitem.headline: KB, Rabobank in alliance talks - magazine.

text.p: Belgian Kredietbank and Dutch Rabobank are holding discrete talks on forging a close alliance, the Belgian Trends weekly magazine said on Thursday.
Trends said discussions were due to be finalised by the summer.
It said the banks were considering a form of cooperation similar to that of Belgo-Dutch financial group Fortis, which combines independent partners Fortis Amev and Fortis AG.
"Contacts in the Netherlands lead...to the conclusion that Rabobank has the biggest chance of becoming the groom of Kredietbank," Trends said.
It said important talks have already been going on for months.
